records.title: Topological Casimir effect in Maxwell Electrodynamics on a Compact Manifold
records.version: v2, submitted 2013-05-20 18:56:59 UTC; arXiv metadata says matches published version
records.extraction: PDF downloaded to temporary storage, pdftotext -layout succeeded; formula text checked against web PDF rendering. No full text copied into tracked files.
records.metadata_caveat: The version-pinned PDF has margin arXiv:1301.1706v2 [hep-th] 20 May 2013, but its generated title-page date is November 27, 2024. Version and source-byte hash are pinned separately; the compile date is not used as revision evidence.
locators_used: Section II A-B, printed pages 2-3, equations (6)-(16)
Section III B, equation (23), dimensional coupling dictionary
Conclusion, equation (38), proposed QCD cosmological extrapolation
records.source_status: Derives the exact two-dimensional partition function and states susceptibility; the QCD inverse-size statement is a physical extrapolation, not established by the 2D formulas.
records.hypotheses: Pure compact U(1) gauge theory on a Euclidean 2-torus, periodic gauge fields up to large gauge transformations, integer flux sectors, no dynamical fermions; finite positive beta,L,e2.
records.notation_dictionary: Source V=beta L becomes A, source e A_source becomes our compact connection A, source plus theta shift is equivalent to our minus shift by n -> -n. Our e2 is source e squared and has mass dimension 2 in 2D. The independent 4D calculation uses e4 dimensionless.
checks_performed: Exact formulas and measure prefactor extracted
Independent Hamiltonian and Poisson derivations in REPORT.md
Asymptotic and metric applications checked explicitly

implication_verdicts.sphere_formula: verified by independent Haar gluing here; not attributed to the torus source
implication_verdicts.all_six_4d_flux_formula: verified by independent direct action calculation here; not attributed to the paper's reduced single magnetic sector
implication_verdicts.linear_H_4d_QCD: inapplicable: gauge theory, dimension, geometry and state do not match

records.overlap_classification: Known after translation of notation for the torus partition function and susceptibility; formal corollary for the computed asymptotic cancellation. No novelty claim.
records.search_scope: Primary arXiv version and its exact formulas, checked 2026-10-19; searches for compact 2D Maxwell torus partition/topological susceptibility. No global literature or novelty coverage claimed.
